summary: Local HTTPS(:443) auth of Tapo cameras (libtapocameranetwork). Session type chosen from TDP discovery: tpap object -> TPAP/SPAKE2+; encrypt_type == ["3"] -> secure v3; else legacy. Username always 'admin'; password = cloud account password (or cloud LAT, or md5(deviceId) when unprovisioned). Legacy: login {hashed:true,password:MD5U}. v3: login{cnonce,encrypt_type:'3',username} -> -40413 {nonce,device_confirm=SHA256U(cnonce+SHA256U(pwd)+nonce)+nonce+cnonce} -> login + digest_passwd=SHA256U(SHA256U(pwd)+cnonce+nonce)+cnonce+nonce -> stok,start_seq. lsk/ivb = SHA256('lsk'|'ivb'+cnonce+nonce+SHA256U(cnonce+SHA256U(pwd)+nonce))[:16]; AES-128-CBC/PKCS7 + base64 in {method:securePassthrough,params:{request}} to /stok=<stok>/ds with headers seq and tapo_tag=SHA256U(SHA256U(SHA256U(pwd)+cnonce)+body+seq); seq post-increments. TLS: trust-all + no hostname check (except TPAP tls==2).

items.description: How the app chooses the local session implementation (legacy / secure v3 / TPAP) for a camera on HTTPS.

value.inputs: TDP discovery result (UDP TDP, see discovery spec): encrypt_type (List<String>), tpap (TDPTpapInfo, nullable), http_port (0 -> 443), tpap_preferred
rules: 1. if tpap object present AND a TPAP authenticator (o21.d) was built -> TPAP session (transport.local.z2) using TLA/SPAKE2+ (see auth.tpap.*)
2. else if encrypt_type list is exactly ["3"] -> LocalSecureSession (secure login v3 + securePassthrough)
3. else -> legacy session transport.local.b2 (MD5 hashed login, plaintext JSON)
value.type_v4_note: encrypt_type ["4"] (isEncryptTypeV4) is a separate local-control flavour; it does not select LocalSecureSession in uk.c (only exact ["3"] does).
value.base_url: https://<ip>:<port>; port = tpap.port if TPAP and >0 else http_port (default 443)

items.description: Expected challenge response to step 1.

app_checks: c(): result.data, data.nonce, data.device_confirm must be non-null else fail 'check loginResultFailData failed'
d(): len(device_confirm) > len(nonce+cnonce) AND device_confirm ends with (nonce + cnonce) else fail 'check device confirm failed'

items.description: Exact device_confirm formula and how the app interprets it.

value.password_hash: SHA256U(password)  (SHA-256 variant; the Android app has NO MD5 variant for encrypt_type 3)
decision: matches with cloud password -> TP_PASSWORD mode; login with cloud password (or, if a cached LAT exists and last LAT sync is older than 24 h, first trigger LAT password sync)
does not match -> LAT mode; if cached LAT matches (same formula with LAT as password) login with LAT; else trigger password sync via cloud then retry
value.external_note: pytapo additionally accepts SHA256U(cnonce + MD5U(password) + nonce) for some firmwares; not present in this app version.

items.description: Session key (lsk) and IV (ivb) derivation.

value.hashed_key: first_hash = SHA256U(cnonce + SHA256U(password) + nonce)  (64-char upper hex string)
value.lsk: SHA-256(UTF-8("lsk" + cnonce + nonce + first_hash))[0:16]  (raw bytes, AES-128 key)
value.ivb: SHA-256(UTF-8("ivb" + cnonce + nonce + first_hash))[0:16]  (raw bytes, CBC IV)
value.note: IV is fixed for the whole session (copyEncryptInfo copies the same ivb for every request and response).

items.description: Payload cipher for securePassthrough.

value.plaintext: UTF-8 JSON of the inner Request (normally multipleRequest)
value.encoding: Base64 standard alphabet, with padding, NO_WRAP (android flag 2)
value.response: result.response is Base64 -> AES-CBC decrypt with same lsk/ivb -> UTF-8 JSON {error_code, result:{responses:[...]}} (or single Response)
value.quirk: on cipher exception the app returns the input bytes unchanged instead of failing

items.description: Encrypted request envelope and endpoint used after secure login.

value.error_handling: outer error_code != 0 -> SecureException(error_code); e.g. -40401 means re-login
value.ble_variant_only: BLE transport adds params.extra = {seq, tapo_tag, token} and escapes '/' as '\/' when computing tag; NOT used over HTTPS

items.description: tapo_tag header computation (HTTPS LocalSecureSession uses SecureUtils.r, no slash escaping).

value.formula: tapo_tag = SHA256U( SHA256U( SHA256U(password) + cnonce ) + body_json + str(seq) )
value.password: the password the session logged in with (cloud pwd, LAT or FFS default)
value.body_json: exact JSON of the outer securePassthrough request, serialized by Gson without HTML escaping and without nulls: {"method":"securePassthrough","params":{"request":"<b64>"}} (must be byte-identical to the POSTed body)
value.seq: decimal integer, same value sent in the seq header

items.description: Sequence number rules.

value.per_request: AtomicInteger.getAndIncrement(): request uses current seq, then seq += 1 (every securePassthrough call, success or failure)
value.reset: reset() sets seq=0 and clears stok, nonce, cnonce, lsk, ivb, pwd before each new login
value.needLogin: true if lsk/ivb missing or seq == 0

items.description: TLS certificate validation behaviour toward the camera.

value.default: Custom X509TrustManager with empty checkServerTrusted (accepts any cert, incl. self-signed) and HostnameVerifier always returning true. No pinning, no fingerprint store, no TOFU.

items.description: CameraErrorCode enum (libtapocameranetwork.common) plus SecureException codes, with the app's recovery action where found.

-40401.name: SESSION_EXPIRED
-40401.action: on a data request: invalid stok/session -> reset and re-login; on a login request: app treats it as password mismatch and sets needSyncPassword=true (cloud password sync) before retrying

-40404.name: DEVICE_BLOCKED
-40404.action: too many failed attempts (lockout); shown as password error in password settings

-40413.name: INVALID_NONCE
-40413.action: normal step-1 challenge for encrypt_type 3; if returned to a non-secure (legacy) session => firmware switched encryption: mark transport unavailable, redo TDP discovery

-40210.name: PROTOCOL_FORMAT_ERROR
-40210.action: treated as invalid secure session -> re-login

items.description: Generic JSON response wrapper for all local calls.
Secure login flow including password-mode branching (LocalSecureSession.e).

steps: reset session; pwd := cloud password; cnonce := random
POST login step1 -> expect -40413 (else if -90000/-90001 -> FFS default login; else return response)
if device_confirm prefix == SHA256U(cnonce+SHA256U(cloudPwd)+nonce): TP_PASSWORD branch -> login step2 with cloud password (optionally LAT sync first)
else LAT branch: if cached LAT matches -> step2 with LAT; else cloud password sync (c2.c/b) then step2 with synced secret; if no LAT and sync fails -> error -40413
step2: derive lsk/ivb, send digest_passwd -> stok + start_seq
on transport error with -40401/-40421/-40210/decrypt error -> reset and repeat
value.retry: tryLogin retried once (b1(1)) when HttpException body is FFS error
